## Background

I hold an undergraduate degree in Statistics and Economics from the University of Toronto. 
Following graduation, I worked as a project assistant managing project timelines, budgets, and conference event organization. 
These responsibilities honed my cross-functional coordination, attention to detail, and operational efficiency in fast-paced environments.

## Why Data Science

My interest began with hands-on R statistical projects in university and grew while observing machine learning applications in my previous role. 
I am driven by the ability to turn complex raw data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders. 
Additionally, I find immense satisfaction in writing code that yields beautiful and reliable results.

## Outside of Data Science

In my free time, I love hitting the trails around Vancouver or spending time in the kitchen baking. 
Exploring nature and trying out new desserts are my favorite ways to recharge.
